patch_description: The editable region already contains a seeded random-points solve() function. Replace its body with a deterministic hybrid optimizer for the 13-point Heilbronn triangle problem: multi-start initialization (3-fold symmetric ring configurations and seeded uniform random starts), targeted local search that moves the vertices of the globally smallest triangle along its area gradient with line search and re-targeting on stalls, followed by a softmin (LogSumExp) polish over all near-minimal triangles. Points are confined to the unit square (unit area, convex). Only moves that strictly improve the true minimum triangle area are accepted, and fixed seeds/iteration counts guarantee reproducibility.
